question_en: Which statements are true? 1) Power is found from $P=Fv\cos\alpha$. 2) The kilowatt-hour is a unit of power. 3) The efficiency of a real machine is always less than 1. 4) With friction, the efficiency of an incline decreases as its angle increases.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Quvvat $P=Fv\cos\alpha$ formula bilan topiladi. 2) Kilovatt-soat — quvvat birligi. 3) Haqiqiy mashinaning FIK i doim 1 dan kichik. 4) Ishqalanish bo'lsa, qiyalik burchagi ortishi bilan qiya tekislikning FIK i kamayadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Мощность находят по формуле $P=Fv\cos\alpha$. 2) Киловатт-час — единица мощности. 3) КПД реальной машины всегда меньше 1. 4) При трении с увеличением угла наклона КПД наклонной плоскости уменьшается.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. kW·h — energiya birligi (2 — noto'g'ri); burchak ortsa FIK ortadi (4 — noto'g'ri).
Asos: η = 1/(1 + μ ctg α).

distractors_en.A: kW·h is a unit of energy
distractors_en.B: statement 1 is true, 2 and 4 are false
distractors_en.D: the efficiency grows with the angle
distractors_en.E: statement 4 is false and 1 is true

question_en: A machine does $5400\ \mathrm{J}$ of work in $3\ \mathrm{min}$. Find its power ($\mathrm{W}$).
question_uz: Mashina $3\ \mathrm{min}$ da $5400\ \mathrm{J}$ ish bajaradi. Uning quvvatini toping ($\mathrm{W}$).
question_ru: Машина совершает работу $5400\ \mathrm{J}$ за $3\ \mathrm{min}$. Найдите её мощность ($\mathrm{W}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. t = 3 min = 180 s; P = 5400/180 = 30 W.
Asos: P = A/t.

distractors_en.B: minutes were not converted to seconds
distractors_en.C: the time was taken as 1 minute
distractors_en.D: the work was multiplied by the time

question_en: How much work does a $0.25\ \mathrm{MW}$ generator do in $0.4\ \mathrm{h}$ ($\mathrm{MJ}$)?
question_uz: Quvvati $0.25\ \mathrm{MW}$ bo'lgan generator $0.4\ \mathrm{h}$ da qancha ish bajaradi ($\mathrm{MJ}$)?
question_ru: Какую работу совершит генератор мощностью $0.25\ \mathrm{MW}$ за $0.4\ \mathrm{h}$ ($\mathrm{MJ}$)?

distractors_ru.E: в 10 раз больше — ошибка во времени

distractors_en.A: hours were not converted to seconds

question_en: A tractor engine has a power of $60$ metric horsepower. How many kilowatts is this ($\mathrm{kW}$)? 1 metric horsepower $\approx736\ \mathrm{W}$.
question_uz: Traktor dvigatelining quvvati $60$ ot kuchi. Bu necha kilovatt ($\mathrm{kW}$)? 1 ot kuchi $\approx736\ \mathrm{W}$.
question_ru: Мощность двигателя трактора $60$ лошадиных сил. Сколько это киловатт ($\mathrm{kW}$)? 1 лошадиная сила $\approx736\ \mathrm{W}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. P = 60·736 = 44 160 W ≈ 44,2 kW.
Asos: 1 ot kuchi ≈ 736 W.

distractors_ru.E: в 10 раз меньше — ошибка в запятой

question_en: A $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ girl climbs stairs to a height of $12\ \mathrm{m}$ in $20\ \mathrm{s}$. Find her average power ($\mathrm{W}$).
question_uz: Massasi $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan qiz zinapoyadan $12\ \mathrm{m}$ balandlikka $20\ \mathrm{s}$ da chiqdi. Uning o'rtacha quvvatini toping ($\mathrm{W}$).
question_ru: Девочка массой $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ поднялась по лестнице на высоту $12\ \mathrm{m}$ за $20\ \mathrm{s}$. Найдите её среднюю мощность ($\mathrm{W}$).

distractors_en.B: the time was taken as 10 s
distractors_en.D: this is the work, not the power

question_en: A force of $25\ \mathrm{N}$ acts on a cart moving at $8\ \mathrm{m/s}$ at an angle of $53^\circ$ to its velocity ($\cos53^\circ=0.6$). Find the power of the force ($\mathrm{W}$).
question_uz: $8\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanayotgan aravachaga $25\ \mathrm{N}$ kuch tezlik yo'nalishiga $53^\circ$ burchak ostida ta'sir qilmoqda ($\cos53^\circ=0.6$). Kuchning quvvatini toping ($\mathrm{W}$).
question_ru: На тележку, движущуюся со скоростью $8\ \mathrm{m/s}$, действует сила $25\ \mathrm{N}$ под углом $53^\circ$ к направлению скорости ($\cos53^\circ=0.6$). Найдите мощность силы ($\mathrm{W}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. P = Fv cos α = 25·8·0,6 = 120 W.
Asos: P = Fv cos α.

distractors_en.C: sin was used instead of cos

question_en: A rocket engine has a thrust of $400\ \mathrm{kN}$ and the rocket's speed is $6\ \mathrm{km/s}$. Find the engine power at that moment ($\mathrm{MW}$).
question_uz: Raketa dvigatelining tortish kuchi $400\ \mathrm{kN}$, raketa tezligi $6\ \mathrm{km/s}$. Shu paytdagi dvigatel quvvatini toping ($\mathrm{MW}$).
question_ru: Сила тяги ракетного двигателя $400\ \mathrm{kN}$, скорость ракеты $6\ \mathrm{km/s}$. Найдите мощность двигателя в этот момент ($\mathrm{MW}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. P = Fv = 4·10⁵·6·10³ = 2,4·10⁹ W = 2400 MW.
Asos: P = Fv.

distractors.A: W dan MW ga o'tkazishda 1000 marta xato

distractors_ru.A: ошибка в 1000 раз при переводе в МВт

distractors_en.A: a factor-1000 error converting to MW
distractors_en.B: the force was divided by the speed

question_en: A car with a power of $36\ \mathrm{kW}$, moving uniformly, covers $1.2\ \mathrm{km}$ in $60\ \mathrm{s}$. Find its driving force ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_uz: Quvvati $36\ \mathrm{kW}$ bo'lgan avtomobil tekis harakatlanib, $60\ \mathrm{s}$ da $1.2\ \mathrm{km}$ yo'l bosdi. Uning tortish kuchini toping ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_ru: Автомобиль мощностью $36\ \mathrm{kW}$, двигаясь равномерно, прошёл $1.2\ \mathrm{km}$ за $60\ \mathrm{s}$. Найдите его силу тяги ($\mathrm{N}$).

distractors_en.B: the distance was used instead of the speed
distractors_en.C: the time was used instead of the speed
distractors_en.D: the power was multiplied by the speed
distractors_en.E: the speed was taken as 10 m/s

question_en: A pump has a useful power of $12\ \mathrm{kW}$. What volume of water does it raise in $1\ \mathrm{h}$ from a depth of $24\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\mathrm{m^3}$)? The density of water is $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_uz: Nasosning foydali quvvati $12\ \mathrm{kW}$. U $1\ \mathrm{h}$ da $24\ \mathrm{m}$ chuqurlikdan qancha hajm suv chiqaradi ($\mathrm{m^3}$)? Suvning zichligi $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_ru: Полезная мощность насоса $12\ \mathrm{kW}$. Какой объём воды он поднимет за $1\ \mathrm{h}$ с глубины $24\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\mathrm{m^3}$)? Плотность воды $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.

question_en: An electric motor has a useful power of $180\ \mathrm{kW}$ and an efficiency of $75$ percent. Find its total power ($\mathrm{kW}$).
question_uz: Elektrodvigatelning foydali quvvati $180\ \mathrm{kW}$, FIK i $75$ foiz. Uning to'liq quvvatini toping ($\mathrm{kW}$).
question_ru: Полезная мощность электродвигателя $180\ \mathrm{kW}$, КПД $75$ процентов. Найдите его полную мощность ($\mathrm{kW}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. P = P₁/η = 180/0,75 = 240 kW.
Asos: η = P₁/P.

distractors_en.A: multiplied by the efficiency instead of dividing

question_en: A crane motor has a power of $8\ \mathrm{kW}$ and an efficiency of $75$ percent. How long does the crane take to lift a $1.2\ \mathrm{t}$ load to a height of $10\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\mathrm{s}$)?
question_uz: Kran dvigatelining quvvati $8\ \mathrm{kW}$, FIK i $75$ foiz. Kran $1.2\ \mathrm{t}$ yukni $10\ \mathrm{m}$ balandlikka qancha vaqtda ko'taradi ($\mathrm{s}$)?
question_ru: Мощность двигателя крана $8\ \mathrm{kW}$, КПД $75$ процентов. За какое время кран поднимет груз $1.2\ \mathrm{t}$ на высоту $10\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\mathrm{s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. ηPt = mgh ⇒ t = 120000/(0,75·8000) = 20 s.
Asos: η = mgh/(Pt).

distractors_en.C: multiplied by the efficiency instead of dividing

question_en: A crane lifted $2880\ \mathrm{t}$ of building materials to a height of $25\ \mathrm{m}$ in $8\ \mathrm{h}$. The crane's efficiency is $50$ percent. Find the power of the crane motor ($\mathrm{kW}$).
question_uz: Ko'tarish krani $8\ \mathrm{h}$ da $2880\ \mathrm{t}$ qurilish materialini $25\ \mathrm{m}$ balandlikka ko'tardi. Kranning FIK i $50$ foiz. Kran dvigatelining quvvatini toping ($\mathrm{kW}$).
question_ru: Подъёмный кран за $8\ \mathrm{h}$ поднял $2880\ \mathrm{t}$ строительных материалов на высоту $25\ \mathrm{m}$. КПД крана $50$ процентов. Найдите мощность двигателя крана ($\mathrm{kW}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. A₁ = 7,2·10⁸ J, t = 28800 s; P = A₁/(ηt) = 50 kW.
Asos: η = mgh/(Pt).

distractors_en.B: multiplied by the efficiency instead of dividing
distractors_en.C: the time was taken in minutes
distractors_en.E: the time was taken in hours

question_en: A load is pulled uniformly up an incline of angle $\alpha$ with coefficient of friction $\mu$ (the force is parallel to the incline). Find the efficiency of the incline.
question_uz: Qiyalik burchagi $\alpha$, ishqalanish koeffitsiyenti $\mu$ bo'lgan qiya tekislik bo'ylab yuk tekis tortib chiqariladi (kuch qiya tekislikka parallel). Qiya tekislikning FIK ini toping.
question_ru: Груз равномерно втаскивают по наклонной плоскости с углом наклона $\alpha$ и коэффициентом трения $\mu$ (сила параллельна плоскости). Найдите КПД наклонной плоскости.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. η = mgh/(FL) = sin α/(sin α + μ cos α) = tg α/(tg α + μ).
Asos: η = mgh/(FL).

en: Divide the numerator and denominator by $\cos\alpha$: $$\eta=\frac{\mathrm{tg}\,\alpha}{\mathrm{tg}\,\alpha+\mu}$$

distractors_en.D: the friction force is written wrongly
distractors_en.E: this is the loss fraction 1 − η

question_en: The water resistance on a ship is proportional to its speed. Because of an engine fault the ship's speed fell by $20$ percent. By what percentage did the engine power fall?
question_uz: Kema harakatiga suvning qarshilik kuchi tezlikka proporsional. Dvigatel nosozligi tufayli kema tezligi $20$ foizga kamaydi. Dvigatel quvvati necha foizga kamaygan?
question_ru: Сила сопротивления воды движению судна пропорциональна скорости. Из-за неисправности двигателя скорость судна уменьшилась на $20$ процентов. На сколько процентов уменьшилась мощность двигателя?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. P = kv², P₂/P = 0,8² = 0,64 — quvvat 36 foizga kamaygan.
Asos: f = kv ⇒ P = kv².

distractors_ru.D: считали, что скорость выросла на 20 процентов

distractors_en.A: the power was taken proportional to the speed
distractors_en.C: this is the new fraction of power
distractors_en.D: the speed was taken to rise by 20 percent

question_en: A ship has three engines. The first engine alone gives the ship a top speed of $6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ and the second $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$; all three together give $7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. The resistance is proportional to speed. What top speed does the third engine alone give ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
question_uz: Kemaning uchta dvigateli bor. Yolg'iz o'zi birinchi dvigatel kemaga $6\ \mathrm{m/s}$, ikkinchisi $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$ eng katta tezlik beradi; uchalasi birga $7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Qarshilik kuchi tezlikka proporsional. Uchinchi dvigatel yolg'iz qanday tezlik beradi ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
question_ru: У судна три двигателя. Первый двигатель один сообщает судну максимальную скорость $6\ \mathrm{m/s}$, второй — $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$; все три вместе — $7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Сила сопротивления пропорциональна скорости. Какую максимальную скорость сообщит судну один третий двигатель ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. P = kv², quvvatlar qo'shiladi: v₃² = 49 − 36 − 4 = 9, v₃ = 3 m/s.
Asos: f = kv ⇒ P = kv².

distractors_en.A: the power was taken proportional to the speed
distractors_en.B: the second engine was left out
distractors_en.D: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.E: the first engine was left out
